prior_protocol.purpose: Original preview model versus current official model: different checkpoints and algorithms; not a software regression or accuracy comparison.
prior_protocol.timing_boundary: New Python process, including imports, CUDA initialisation, model loading and prediction; excluding container creation, setup, validation and warmup.
prior_protocol.primary_memory: PyTorch peak CUDA allocated/reserved bytes over the complete child CLI; main-process RSS reported separately; never summed.
prior_protocol.system_memory: Sampled MemTotal minus MemAvailable; whole-system footprint and increase above pre-run baseline, not isolated process memory.

limitations: Models/weights differ between original and official. Model-agreement checks do not measure biological accuracy.
Two timed repeats, fixed order and one seed; small differences may be noise.
Stage profiles include instrumentation/first-use overhead; CUDA-event intervals include stream-idle gaps and are not isolated kernel busy time.
System memory is sampled MemTotal minus MemAvailable, includes background processes and is not isolated model memory.
The cache is qualified for the pinned official source and ordinary inference only, not training or every future model/version.
